# TradeKit

> TradeKit is a free, open-source trade document generator for international trade. It supports 19 types of trade documents with bilingual (Chinese/English) support and one-click A4 landscape PDF export. All data is stored locally in the browser and never uploaded.

- **Website**: http://tradekit.treedeep.cn/
- **Home Page**: http://tradekit.treedeep.cn/index.html
- **License**: Open Source
- **Price**: Free
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, html2pdf.js (CDN)
- **Data Storage**: localStorage (browser-only, no server)
- **Languages**: Chinese (zh-CN), English (en-US)

## Key Features
- **19 Trade Documents**: Cover all major international trade document types
- **Bilingual Support**: Chinese and English side-by-side display
- **A4 PDF Export**: One-click landscape PDF export via html2pdf.js
- **Local Data**: All data stored in browser localStorage, never uploaded
- **No Signup Required**: Open and use immediately
- **Dark Mode**: Built-in light/dark theme toggle
- **History/Snapshots**: Auto-save document snapshots on PDF export
- **Auto Calculation**: Automatic totals, weights, and values

## Use Cases
- Export/import companies generating trade documents
- Freight forwarders preparing shipping documentation
- Manufacturers providing quotations and invoices to foreign buyers
- Trading companies managing contracts and certificates
- Students learning international trade documentation

## Common Questions

- **Q: Is TradeKit free? / TradeKit 免费吗？**
  A: Yes, completely free and open source. No signup or login required. / 是的，完全免费开源，无需注册或登录。

- **Q: Where is my data stored? / 数据存储在哪里？**
  A: All data is stored locally in your browser's localStorage. Nothing is uploaded to any server. / 所有数据存储在浏览器 localStorage 中，不会上传到任何服务器。

- **Q: What documents can I generate? / 能生成哪些单证？**
  A: 19 types including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Trade Contract, Certificate of Origin, Insurance Policy, Customs Declaration, Inspection Certificate, Fumigation Certificate, and more. / 19 种单证，包括商业发票、装箱单、提单、合同、原产地证明、保险单、报关单、检验证书、熏蒸证书等。

- **Q: What languages are supported? / 支持哪些语言？**
  A: Bilingual Chinese (zh-CN) and English (en-US) with side-by-side display on document previews. / 中英双语（简体中文和英语），预览页面中英对照显示。

- **Q: What format is the exported PDF? / 导出的PDF是什么格式？**
  A: A4 landscape format with professional trade document layout, suitable for printing and electronic transmission. / A4横版格式，专业商业单证排版，适合打印和电子传输。
